title: Edit lines
purpose: Enter what kind of material a request asks for and how much, one line per kind.
summary: What kind of material a request asks for and how much, one line per kind.

tasks.title: Enter the lines
steps: For each kind of material choose the [[Specimen type]] and [[Count (specimens)]], and optionally a minimum amount and [[Study]].
Give the reason and select [[Save lines]].

tasks.title: Submit the request
steps: Back on the request, select [[Submit for decision]].

good_to_know: Lines can be changed only while the request is a draft or returned for changes.
Saving replaces all lines with the grid. The change is kept in the timeline.
A minimum amount is a warning at allocation, which can be confirmed.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators, while the request is a draft or returned for changes. Otherwise the grid is shown read-only with the reason. It opens in a wide dialog that can be maximized.

sections.title: The grid
paragraphs: One row per line, from 1 to 50. Add line adds an empty row and Remove takes a row out; both only change the grid and record nothing, and both work without JavaScript. A line that already has allocations (after a reopened approval) keeps its type, study and minimum amount; only its count and notes can change, it cannot be removed, and its count cannot go below the specimens already allocated to it.

items.label: Line
items.description: The line number, kept for existing lines; new lines take the next number.

items.label: Minimum amount each, Unit
items.description: Optional, together: the smallest amount each specimen should hold, as an exact decimal in the chosen unit. Allocation warns about specimens below it and asks for confirmation.

items.label: Study
items.description: Optional: only specimens governed by this study.

items.label: Notes
items.description: Optional, up to 500 characters, about the material asked for. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Save lines needs a reason (suggested for a new request's first lines) and replaces the request's lines with the grid; the change is kept in the timeline. Errors about a line are shown above the grid with its number. If someone changed the record after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay in the form and the next save uses the current version.
